verdict.rationale: Capacities docs confirm a template system that lets you prefill properties and blocks of an object type, which supports reusable templates for recurring note kinds (e.g., Meetings, Projects) as suggested by the object-type-first workflow. However, no evidence describes dynamic variable insertion (e.g., auto-filled current date or title placeholders) within templates. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of variable/placeholder support (date, title, etc.) in templates and independent hands-on confirmation of this behavior.
